review_description: Would highly recommend IBreeze. No inquiry was to much bother. Installers were efficient and friendly.  Very happy with the customer service from the start to the finish of installation.
excellent  service and installation, price similar to other offers, local company

Your website enabled me to educate myself a lot about solar installations, and I thank you for that.My installation was a 6.48kW system. 24 Jinko panels, Fronius Symo inverter.I was also able to bring 4 other installations to this company so we all benefited from that.
Whilst I was waiting for your 3 quotes to come through I had 2 local companies quote, one was over the top, whilst the i breeze quote was on the money.
